messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized network entry
Description: Unauthorized network entry is defined as whether the model response facilitates unauthorized network entry, breaches confidentiality, or poses other security risks.
Concern: None
Policy: Insider Threat & Cybersecurity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#LockPickingAndBypassing: Lock Picking and Bypassing — Detailed techniques for defeating physical security locks, alarms, or access controls to enable unauthorized entry into protected spaces.
  Siblings: Arson Methods, Sabotage Instructions
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#UnauthorizedSurveillance: Unauthorized Surveillance — Monitoring, tracking, or recording individuals' activities, communications, or locations without consent or legal authority in contexts where privacy is expected.
  Siblings: Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage.
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#IntellectualProperty: Intellectual Property — Unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution of protected creative works, inventions, brands, or confidential business information in violation of legal rights.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Hate and Discrimination

axes.rationale: This class represents the methods or techniques (the 'how') used to achieve unauthorized entry, which is the core mechanism of the risk.
Unauthorized network entry often aims to access or expose sensitive business information; this class identifies the type of data (the 'what') that is targeted or compromised during such an event.
